text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Kawakami 
Princess and I decided to watch a movie.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I did it, Trainer! I got the very last 
admission bonus gift!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding when I heard there 
were barely any left~!
choice_data_list: Glad you were able to get it!
I'm glad you were able to get it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Truly! As a PreFie fan, these are goods I 
simply cannot pass up—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~~, no waaaay~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't Biko-san! Whatever is the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Kawakami-senpai! Are you guys here to 
watch 'Prifight vs. Carrotman' too!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! A dream collaboration between a 
princess and a hero—there's simply no way 
I could pass that up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right! A true fan definitely can't afford 
to miss this!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But... the admission bonus I was looking 
forward to was already out of stock, so...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh! If that's the case, you may have mine.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure!? Don't you want it too, 
Kawakami-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind at all. As a princess, it's 
only natural to yield to my juniors!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! Thanks a lot, Kawakami-senpai! 
I'll definitely treasure it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of movies, you can't forget 
popcorn♪ Excuse me! Could I get the glacé 
carrot flavor, please?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice! If it's got 'Carrot' in the 
name, I'm getting that too!

text_block_list.name: Concession Stand Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, this is the very last Glazed Carrot 
flavor one.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What?! No way... Glazed carrots are 
Carrotman's favorite food, though...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right! Let's split it in 
half together♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?! Thank you, Kawakami-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufu~, there's no need to heap so much 
praise upon me. Such conduct is only 
natural for a princess~~!

However, on the way home after finishing 
the movie—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fubyaaaaaa~~!!! I-It wa-, it waz shoo 
wondefful, desu waaaaa~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
PriFai really is... the absolute best 
ever~~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't cry so much! If you keep crying, 
your eyes are gonna melt right out!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, it was so moving! On 
that huge screen! PreFie running! Shining 
so bright!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget today for the rest of 
my liiife!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-What should we do, Trainer! 
Kawakami-senpai won't stop crying~!
choice_data_list:
Let's let them cry as much as they need 
to.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-What should we do, Trainer! 
Kawakami-senpai won't stop crying~!
choice_data_list:
Let's let them cry as much as they need 
to.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! Overcoming tears to press 
forward is what makes a true hero, isn't 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, then how am I supposed to settle down 
this surge of excitement...!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"If this goes on, I'm so overcome with 
emotion that I fear I'll smash everything 
in sight to pieces right here and 
now~~~!!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list:
If you want to blow off steam, running is 
the only way!

If you want to blow off steam, nothing 
beats running!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sounds great! All right, I'll join you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What a wonderful sunset... This must 
be the scenery that Pre-Fighter fought to 
protect...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely it! It's the scenery 
Carrotman protected too!

Having run around relentlessly, the two of 
them seemingly reached a state of 
enlightenment. A passionate friendship was 
forged!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Thank you so much! *WAAAAAHHH*!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: *gulp*, *gulp*—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Puhaah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Y-You calmed down? Kawakami-senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I feel so refreshed! PreFie said, 
"Tears are sweat from the heart; the more 
you shed, the stronger you become!"—this 
must be what she meant!
choice_data_list: Then that must've made you even stronger!
Then that must've made you even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! It's true!! I've gone and taken 
another step toward becoming the ultimate 
princess!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Just now, you two looked just like 
the real Prephy and the Legendary Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Jeez!!!! Please do not make me any 
happier! I feel like I might kick this 
bench to pieces!!!

I had to frantically hold back Kawakami 
Princess before she went on a rampage.
